Title: AR10IR-OE - SPARK PLUG AR10IR-OE (KTM)*
Body (HTML): Description AR10IR-OE – SPARK PLUG AR10IR-OE (KTM OEM) THE SPARK PLUG The BRISK AR10IR-OE is an OEM-developed Iridium Racing spark plug designed in cooperation with KTM, GASGAS and Husqvarna factory racing teams for modern 50cc and 65cc SX, MC and TC models (2024 onwards). Developed through joint testing and race-level validation, this plug was engineered to guarantee reliable ignition across the entire power range of high-revving mini motocross engines. With performance-focused updates in modern race bikes, the AR10IR-OE ensures consistent combustion, improved throttle response, and enhanced reliability under extreme conditions. IRIDIUM RACING TECHNOLOGY Iridium is up to 6–8 times stronger than platinum and has a melting point approximately 1200°C higher, making it exceptionally durable under high-pressure, high-output race conditions. The BRISK Racing Iridium “Power Focus” design positions the spark precisely in the focal point of the reflector, directing the air/fuel mixture during compression toward the centre electrode. Rust Destroya is a completely soluble, crystalline-granular product. Dissovled in water it produces a safe, powderful and reusable soak solution for removing corrosion from ferrous metal surfaces. Unlike acidic rust removers, Rust Destroya will not damage the substrate metal. DIRECTIONS EYE PROTECTION AND PROTECTIVE GLOVES SHOULD BE WORN AT ALL TIMES. Dissolve 1Kg of Rust Destroya in 19L of water. Use warm to hot tap water to speed the solubilisation. If a smaller volume of soak solution is required a 5% solution by weight is recommended (1 part Rust Destroya to 19 parts water). For most applications, a 5% solution is sufficent but higher concentrations may be used for heavy corrosion. Typical Applications             5% Solution 1 Part* Rust Destroya to        19 Parts Water *By Weight Heavy Corrosion      Up to 20% Solution 1 Part* Rust Destroya to          4 Parts Water Use plastic or stainless steel containers for Rust Destroya solution. Steel or Galvanised Iron should not be used. Test Rust Destroya on a inconspicuous and painted place on item before use. Dirt, grease, oil and other contaminants should be removed from items to be treated. Loose or flaky rust should be removed mechanically prior to treatment. The rusted surface must be completely submerged in the soak solution by tilting and rolling item to ensure air bubbles are removed. Inspect the item periodically and brush with a stiff-bristled brush to remove loosened rust and surface build up. Continue soaking until the surface is clean and rust free. When all of the rust has been removed, brush as necessary, rinse with water and dry. Rust Destroya soak solution will work in as little as 20 minutes for light rust or overnight for heavily rusted metal. Speed of rust removal action is temperature dependent; warm = faster, cold = slower. Very fast rust removal can be achieved by heating the soak solution to 50°C-70°C using an immerison heater. The soak solution may be re-used until its colour changes to very dark yellow / black. Note: Rust Destroya soak solution does not etch metal surfaces. If repairing a petrol tank.
